  • 3. Aṭṭhasatapariyāyavagga 3. The Explanation of the Hundred and Eight

Suddhikasutta Plain Version

“Tisso imā, bhikkhave, vedanā. “Mendicants, there are these three feelings. Katamā tisso? What three? Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā—Pleasant, painful, and neutral feelings. imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso vedanā”ti. These are the three feelings.”

Dasamaṁ.
